nodes.name: customelementregistry.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the CustomElementRegistry API, managing registration, lifecycle callbacks, and element upgrades for custom elements per the HTML specification.

nodes.name: CustomElementState
nodes.summary: Enum representing the lifecycle states of a custom element (undefined, failed, uncustomized, precustomized, custom).

nodes.name: CustomElementRegistry
nodes.summary: Manages custom element registration, definition lookup, and lifecycle callback extraction per the HTML Custom Elements specification.

nodes.name: LifecycleCallbacks
nodes.summary: Structure containing all lifecycle callbacks for a custom element definition.

nodes.name: ConstructionStackEntry
nodes.summary: Element construction stack entry for tracking custom element construction lifecycle.

nodes.name: CustomElementDefinition
nodes.summary: Defines a registered custom element with its constructor, observed attributes, and lifecycle callbacks.

nodes.name: CustomElementReaction
nodes.summary: A reaction entry for custom element lifecycle callback or upgrade processing.

nodes.name: CallbackReaction
nodes.summary: Enum of supported custom element lifecycle reactions (connected, disconnected, adopted, attribute changed, etc.).

nodes.name: CustomElementReactionStack
nodes.summary: Manages the element reaction queue for processing custom element lifecycle reactions.

nodes.name: ElementQueue
nodes.summary: Queue of custom elements awaiting lifecycle reaction invocation.

nodes.summary: Looks up a custom element definition by its constructor function.

nodes.summary: Traverses the node tree to find the applicable custom element registry.

nodes.name: get_callback

nodes.name: Constructor

nodes.summary: Executes the custom element constructor during element upgrade.
